notes.title: Halloween Update + Song-Contest
notes.content:
Hello everyone!! We're excited to announce to you the [b]ODDADA Halloween Update [/b] 🎃

Not only does this upgrade include a small content update with: 
[list]
[*]a new spooky scale
[*]2 new sound pieces
[*]3 new stickers
[/list]

But also:

We are launching a Halloween Song Contest on our Discord server starting today, on the 27th of October, until the 3rd of November!

There's 3 prizes to be won - in the form of Steam gift cards - in the following 3 categories:

🎃 = most spooky (10€)
🌈 = most creative (10€)
🎹 = banger award (10€)

So make sure to join our [url=https://discord.gg/eYH6jp7VYP]DISCORD[/url] and show us your spoooookiest creations 👻

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11
notes.content:
We're excited to bring you the latest update for ODDADA!

This version includes several stability improvements and preparations for the things to come. 🙂

Thank you for your continued support! 

Have questions or want to report a bug? Feel free to join our Discord community! 
We're always here to help and love hearing back from you.

[h3]Controls[/h3]
[list]
[*]Made [b]Knobs[/b] interactable via both horizontal and vertical mouse movements.
[*]Made [b]Knobs[/b] interactable via controller.
[/list]
[h3]Menus & UI[/h3]
[list]
[*]Resolved a visual glitch where the [b]train's roof[/b] would jump when clicked. 
[*]Fixed possible [b]color bleeding[/b] during transitions between scenes.
[*]Updated the [b]icon[/b] for the Desktop Shortcut for [b]Windows[/b].
[*]Updated [b]Splash Screen[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Localization[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a text break issue in the Train Screen for [b]French[/b]. 
[/list]
[h3]Save System[/h3]
[list]
[*]Optimized the performance and resilience for saving cassettes.
[*]Prepared save files and UI for future updates.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Tracking[/h3]
[list]
[*]Enhanced [b]local logging system[/b] to make it easier finding bugs in the future.
  [list]
  [*][b]Important[/b]: This logging system is completely offline and local to your device. We do not have access to these logs unless you choose to send them to us. If you encounter issues and wish to share your logs for support, you'll need to manually send them to us.
  [/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Hey there! So it already has been over a month since we released the demo during Next Fest.
Currently, we are in the midst of making our game ready for our big release [b]THIS SUMMER[/b].

In the meantime, we thought you’d enjoy a new version of the demo with some of the improvements we made so far. :) 
Without any further ado, here are the changes:

[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[h3]Plattenboy Level - Upgrade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862512/59bf3679ea2d7b0391013ea867fdbe0dc4e4849f.gif[/img]The Plattenboy got a whole new additional device to explore and tinker with.

[h3]Chord Towers Level - Camera Angle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40862512/c7798a23d4a16d2f1fa93f4e352243758858756d.gif[/img]It’s easier now to reach the towers in the back.

[h3]Performance Improvements[/h3]
We were able to boost the FPS by about 3x to 5x on our test system from 2015 (Intel i7 with integrated graphics). So should the game have caused some trouble for your GPU in the past, maybe now is the perfect time to give it another go.

[h2]Further Changes and Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Levels[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Plattenboy[/b] - Got a completely new device to play around with.
[*] [b]Chord Towers[/b] - It is easier now to reach the towers in the back. 
[*] [b]Organ[/b] - Does record more precisely now when a key was pressed.
[*] [b]Sound Bricks[/b] are harder to lose inside levels now.
[*] Fixed possible [b]Camera [/b]clipping during level transitions.
[/list]
[h3]Train[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Loco[/b] - When recording, the window will be red and blinking now.
[/list]
[h3]Cassettes[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Song Exporter[/b] - By default, the UI will hide your username in the file path now.
[*] [b]Song Exporter[/b] - The UI got overall simplified by removing unnecessary buttons.
[*] [b]Song Exporter[/b] - When done exporting, the computer shows a checkmark now.
[*] [b]Cassette Player[/b] - The non-interactable playhead now looks less interactable.
[*] [b]Cassette Editor[/b] - The cassette slot now looks more like a slot.
[*] [b]Cassette Editor[/b] - The “?” key got replaced with a “ “ key (space).
[*] Untitled [b]Cassettes[/b] without a title get the title “Untitled” now.
[*] Titles of [b]Cassettes[/b] are perfectly horizontally centered now.
[*] Fixed a possible bug preventing a cassette to not be saved.
[/list]
[h3]Sounds[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Cassette Box[/b] - Got some new latch sounds.
[/list]
[h3]Graphics[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Performance Optimisations[/b]
[*] [b]Anti-aliasing[/b] is optional now. You can find a toggle in the Settings.
[*] [b]MacBooks[/b] with a [b]Notch[/b] now use the full width of the screen by default.
[/list]
[h3]Menus & UI[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Localisation[/b] - Added Russian translation.
[*] Improved text wrapping for [b]Spanish[/b] and [b]Portuguese[/b].
[/list]
[h3]Miscellaneous[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Concert[/b] - Fixed a possible bug getting stuck in the Concert.
[/list]

notes.title: Save & Sound - A celebration of music in games!
notes.content:
[h2]Get ready![/h2]

Join us July 14 - 18 right here on Steam for one of the largest digital expos about audio and music in games. Featuring concerts, deep-dives, and mashups from 70+ developers from around the world, prepare your eyes & ears for a unique event!

Starting at 10am PDT / 7pm CEST, a 4-day live show from July 14 to 17 will stream showcasing all the wonderful content made just for Save & Sound. 

We will show lots of new footage of ODDADA!

[h2]Don’t miss out on updates![/h2]

Set a reminder to be notified when Save & Sound will go live!

The show will be streamed on the Save & Sound website. Check out all the games part of the event on [url=saveandsound.io]saveandsound.io[/url]
